name: Papra
author: Alwin Antreich
description: Save attachments to Papra and attach documents from Papra to new mail. Each user connects their own Papra API key to the server the admin sets.

serverUrl.label: Papra server URL
serverUrl.description: For example https://papra.example.com. Users connect their API key to this server only; the plugin does nothing until it is set.

defaultTags.label: Default tags
defaultTags.description: Comma-separated tag names added to every document saved from Bulwark, for example Bulwark. Create them in each Papra organisation: the plugin creates no tags and skips one the organisation doesn't have. Users need an API key with tags:read and documents:update for tagging.
